item.title: 'It's not fair': CMSD parents frustrated over 'last-minute' decision to cancel class once again
item.description: CMSD was supposed to be open on Wednesday, but parents say a "last-minute" decision was made to cancel, leaving families struggling to find accommodations or rearrange their day.

item.title: Cavaliers spoil LeBron James' return, riding big 3rd quarter to 129-99 romp
item.description: Donovan Mitchell scored 25 points, Jaylon Tyson had 20 and the Cleveland Cavaliers used a big third quarter to beat the Los Angeles Lakers 129-99 and spoil LeBron James’ return to Northeast Ohio

item.title: Cockroach infestation at an Akron apartment building leads USPS to suspend mail service
item.description: Several signs were posted on dozens of tenants’ mailboxes to let residents at an Akron apartment know their mail service has been disrupted after cockroaches were found in their mailboxes.
